analysis.rationale: Standalone net profit surged 67% YoY and consolidated net profit more than doubled, driven by strong revenue growth and lower impairment allowances. The board also approved a Rs 4,000 crore fund raise, indicating expansion plans.
analysis.summary: Piramal Finance reported Q1 FY27 standalone net profit of Rs 460.98 crore (vs Rs 276.37 crore YoY) and consolidated net profit of Rs 661.13 crore (vs Rs 309.50 crore YoY), with revenue from operations at Rs 3,368.27 crore (standalone) and Rs 3,429.54 crore (consolidated).
